method: Plain anonymous HTTP GET (curl). No logins, cookies, tokens or API keys.
shrug: NOT used. No SHRUG (devdatalab) file or SHRUG-derived file was downloaded. The ramSeraph census-2011 release also hosts shrug-* assets; those were deliberately NOT fetched. SubDistricts_2011.parquet is a different asset from that release, sourced from NIC BharatMaps (its attribute schema - OBJECTID, Subdt_LGD, Dist_LGD, Tot_pop, Pop_den, Shape_Length - is the ArcGIS/BharatMaps schema, not SHRUG's pc11_* ids).

files.validated: 5,966 parts / 5,912 distinct non-blank codes (+6 blank-code parts: PoK/Aksai Chin/Kachchh remnants, pop 0). After dissolve by code: 5,907 of 5,922 official 2011 sub-district codes (5,943 of 5,958 sub-district x district rows) have a polygon; 15 codes (pop 3,413,682) have none; 5 of the matches are inferred re-codings of miscoded parts (flagged). 26 of the 30 official 'Area not under any Sub-district' (99999) remainders (pop 26,798,454: West Bengal municipalities, Tripura, Bangalore BBMP...) have no polygon of their own - their land is inside neighbouring sub-district polygons (sub-districts cover 99.6% of district area). See subdistricts_2011_match.csv. stcode11/dtcode11 in this file are CURRENT (2019+) state/district codes (38=Ladakh, 36=Telangana, 7xx=new districts), NOT 2011 - only sdtcode11 is a 2011 key.
